   "source": [
    "# This cell is removed with the tag: \"remove-input\"\n",
    "# As such, it will not be shown in documentation\n",
    "\n",
    "import warnings\n",
    "warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "cdd1a43f",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "(Tutorial_Get_forces)=\n",
    "# Get forces\n",
    "\n",
    "*Extracting atomic force vectors and scalar magnitudes from molecular mechanics force fields.*\n",
    "\n",
    "The function {func}`molsysmt.molecular_mechanics.get_forces` evaluates the negative gradient of the potential energy with respect to atomic coordinates ($-\\nabla U$).\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{versionadded} 1.0.0\n",
    ":::\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{admonition} API documentation\n",
    ":class: dropdown\n",
    "\n",
    "Follow this link for a detailed description of the input arguments, raised errors, and returned objects of this function: {func}`molsysmt.molecular_mechanics.get_forces`.\n",
    ":::\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "084cb25b",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    ":::{note} Molecular Mechanics Backend Engine\n",
    ":class: dropdown\n",
    "\n",
    "Molecular mechanics and force evaluations in MolSysMT are executed using backend simulation engines (currently **OpenMM** by default). MolSysMT intentionally unifies the Pythonic interface and data structures while delegating energy evaluations, parameterizations, and gradient calculations to high-performance, battle-tested molecular simulation engines.\n",
    ":::\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "44202b60",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Basic usage\n",
    "\n",
    "Let's evaluate the residual atomic force vectors on a relaxed Trp-Cage miniprotein:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "d1441d42",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:38:40.955682Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:38:40.955294Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:38:41.991162Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:38:41.989706Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import molsysmt as msm\n",
    "import pyunitwizard as puw\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "6e644356",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:38:41.995024Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:38:41.994441Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:38:52.399949Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:38:52.398264Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "molsys = msm.convert(msm.systems['Trp-Cage']['1l2y.h5msm'], structure_indices=0)\n",
    "molsys_min = msm.molecular_mechanics.potential_energy_minimization(molsys)\n",
    "context = msm.convert(molsys_min, to_form='openmm.Context')\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "a80199ab",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    ":::{note} Demo Systems Catalog\n",
    ":class: dropdown\n",
    "\n",
    "This tutorial uses demonstration datasets provided by MolSysMT. To explore the full catalog of bundled systems, forms, and file paths, visit the {ref}`Demo Systems <user-foundations-entrance-demo-systems>` guide.\n",
    ":::\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "d7d155a7",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We extract the 3D atomic force vectors acting on the system:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "9fa56bf9",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:38:52.403820Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:38:52.403040Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:38:52.427715Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:38:52.426817Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Forces array shape (n_atoms, 3): (304, 3)\n",
      "First 5 atomic force vectors (kJ/(mol*nm)):\n",
      " [[-203.52891418538445 -59.48664780872133 -41.75353447795948] [5.266354881566144 19.56653812680109 12.627775171915474] [-12.145142046770047 -11.768486409033017 5.129915645151726] [-1.461332942163267 -4.805862072016566 9.03546569932422] [0.06741908959327958 12.002086706279599 22.31171933490519]] kilojoule / mole / nanometer\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "forces = msm.molecular_mechanics.get_forces(context)\n",
    "print('Forces array shape (n_atoms, 3):', forces.shape)\n",
    "print('First 5 atomic force vectors (kJ/(mol*nm)):\\n', forces[:5])\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "f56f05ca",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Force magnitudes and residue profiles\n",
    "\n",
    "Setting `magnitude=True` calculates the scalar Euclidean norm of the forces ($\\|\\mathbf{F}_i\\|$) for each atom:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "155db209",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:38:52.439338Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:38:52.438809Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:38:53.469491Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:38:53.468407Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 800x350 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "force_mags = msm.molecular_mechanics.get_forces(context, magnitude=True)\n",
    "mag_vals = puw.get_value(force_mags, to_unit='kJ/(mol*nm)')\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3.5))\n",
    "ax.plot(range(len(mag_vals)), mag_vals, color='firebrick', marker='o', markersize=3, linewidth=1.2)\n",
    "ax.set_title('Atomic Force Magnitudes on Minimized Trp-Cage')\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel('Atom Index')\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel('Force Magnitude (kJ/(mol$\\cdot$nm))')\n",
    "ax.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.4)\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "563e82d5",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Visualizing atomic force magnitudes in 3D\n",
    "\n",
    "We can color the 3D molecular structure by atomic force magnitudes to inspect the spatial distribution of mechanical forces:\n"
